source: Nur Engineering GmbH, 'Movetrics FDT analog outputs: scale per channel', 27 Oct 2026, FDT firmware 1.2.8.22 (project files: hardware/Nur-Engineering_FDT_analog_outputs_2026-10-27.pdf)
applies_to: FDTs with the analog interface board, firmware 1.2.8.22 and later in the firmware team's firmware line. Before 1.2.8.21 the moment outputs of a double plate were 100 times too large and values past full scale wrapped around.
zero: 0 V = zeroed plate; the FDT zeroes at power-up, reset and the software's Zero command; no separate analog zero
value_from_volts: value = volts * units_per_volt (wire signs: fy and mx are the reverse of Studio's and of the vocabulary's plate frame)
signs: Fz positive for a load pressing on the plate; other force and moment channels carry the FDT wire sign. CoP sign and origin are not stated by the maker.
resolution: the stream carries whole N, N·m and cm, so each output moves in steps of its mv_per_unit; CoP therefore in 1 cm steps
clip: values past full scale stay at the end of the range
update: only while streaming; at most 500 updates/s per plate (every frame at 500/s, every second frame at 1000/s); hold the last value after STOP, 0 V at power-up
filters: the FDT's digital low-pass (50 Hz default) plus a first-order output low-pass at about 220 Hz (schematic, not measured)
evidence: maker's document; one unit metered on 27 Oct 2026: Fz and Mx within 1 % of the digital values (164 N, 24.6 N·m), zero near 0 mV
